F1_availability_applicability.predecessor_counterexample: Unscoped domain contracts ('security', 'unrelated') leaked into chunks ('backend/calendar/service.py') merely because target_profile:domain_contracts was present in chunk.contracts, violating Availability != Applicability. Unscoped review packs also attached to all chunks as if global (NoScope != Global).
F1_availability_applicability.mechanism: Format-aware applicability via detect_domain_contracts_format() and detect_review_packs_format(). In modern mapping, unscoped domain contracts match ONLY IF required by an applicable pack, explicitly referenced, explicitly scoped, or declared is_global=True; unscoped packs match ONLY IF explicitly selected or declared is_global=True.
F1_availability_applicability.successor: CM-A3-AVAILABILITY-IS-NOT-APPLICABILITY and CM-A3-UNSCOPED-PACK-IS-NOT-GLOBAL pass cleanly: only calendar_pack and calendar are applicable to calendar chunk; security and unrelated are excluded.
F1_availability_applicability.ablation: AB-A3-AVAILABILITY-APPLICABILITY proves that removing availability/applicability separation causes unrelated and security to leak into calendar chunk (RED under ablation).
F1_availability_applicability.positives: PC-A3-APPLICABLE-PACK-BINDS-CONTRACT, PC-A3-EXPLICIT-CONTRACT-REF, PC-A3-EXPLICIT-GLOBAL, PC-A3-EXPLICIT-SELECTED-PACK all PASS.
